tmp:0794: beno yihyeh talmid-chakham — the outcome that one's son becomes a Torah scholar, secured by blessing the Torah first and rooting study in the primal divine thought (Nedarim 81a)
tmp:0795: banim chayim v'kayamim — living, enduring children, granted through marital union in holiness and breaking the animal soul (Nedarim 20b)
tmp:0798: madregat Avraham — the spiritual level/rank of Avraham, i.e. the ba'al nefesh whose every meal is Lechem HaPanim ('walk before Me')
tmp:0799: ba'al nefesh — 'master of the soul,' one who rules his appetites; the Avraham-level eater whose meals are the aspect of the Showbread
tmp:0800: ba'alei lashon hara u'machloket — slanderers and quarrel-mongers who spy about (meraglim, the 'regel/foot') separating friends and spouses ('nirgan mafrid aluf')
tmp:0806: charuvin — carob trees (of R. Chanina ben Dosa's sustenance), identified as the aspect of 'beroshim' (cypresses) in the symbolism of faith
tmp:0808: beriah b'foal — creation in actuality, the Torah's mode ('amon/uman,' craftsman-actor) as opposed to prayer's creation-in-potential (Chokhmah)
tmp:0809: beriat ha'olam — the creation of the world, effected within the chalal hapanuy (Vacated Space) after tzimtzum, via divine speech; the paradigm of machloket (dispute)
tmp:0813: chok — 'statute' (Ps. 81 'ki chok l'Yisrael hu'), the aspect of the brit/covenant sealed in the flesh ('chok bish'ero sam')
tmp:0814: brit ila'ah — the supernal covenant, aspect of the sun, enclothed in Metatron/the Ziz-bird's wing (lower unification)
tmp:0815: the state in which humiliations and bloodshed come upon a person — degradations suffered before teshuvah, while Ehyeh/Keter is still hidden from him
tmp:0816: am — the people/masses, the 'flesh' (basar) relative to the true sage who is their soul/essence (etzem), broken by hearing his sigh
tmp:0818: bat ayin — the pupil (black) of the eye, the contracting blackness that limits and contains great things; linked to Avraham's daughter 'Bakol' (Bava Batra 16b)
tmp:0825: hitdabkut b'tzaddikim — attachment/closeness to the tzaddikim, the virtue that guides the perpetually soul-thirsty ('tzam'ah nafshi') so they not drink 'foul water'
tmp:0829: raglo — 'his foot' (of Yosef, Gen. 41:44), symbol of gevurot/severities and speech ('tzedek yikra'ehu l'raglo'), paired against 'his hand'=mochin
tmp:0834: giddul hanefesh — the raising/growth of the soul with its pains ('as one mourns a firstborn,' tza'ar hagiddul), companion to the soul's difficult birth
tmp:0837: geder adam — the defining category 'man' (as opposed to beast), attained through tzedakah ('na'aseh adam'), the status of possessing speech
tmp:0838: gevanin — the colors (fire and water = shamayim), the hues shining from supernal Imma into the tefillin
tmp:0840: sak — the sack (of Yosef's brothers), symbol of the body that fasting empties yet in which the 'bundle of money'/desire remains bound
tmp:0841: ofanim she'baTorah — the 'wheels' (Ofanim-angels) within Torah, identified as the bodies of halakhot (gufei halakhot)
tmp:0842: gufei halakhot — the essential corpora/bodies of halakhic law, which are the Ofanim ('wheels') of the Torah's Chariot
tmp:0844: galgalim — the celestial spheres/wheels, which charity embodies ('a wheel that revolves in the world,' Shabbat 151b)
tmp:0845: the blemishing of faith, prayer, and Eretz Yisrael — the sin-state (Avraham's 'How will I know?') that causes descent into Egypt/exile, the anti-miracle realm
tmp:0847: chesron emunah — deficiency of faith, the root cause of exile (Song 4:8 'me'rosh amanah'), faith being the aspect of prayer and miracles
tmp:0848: galut Mitzrayim — the Egyptian exile, archetype of all exiles, incurred by blemished faith/prayer; Egypt being the inversion of miracles and prayer
tmp:0850: 'l'hafnot eilekha kol rish'ei aretz' — the Aleinu phrase 'to turn to You all the wicked of the earth,' interpreted as the converts (gerim)
tmp:0853: mi'shalom — speech's derivation from peace ('adabrah na shalom,' Ps. 122:8): peace/love as the precondition enabling the words of prayer
tmp:0858: Torah studied in a person's distress, in poverty and hardship — night-Torah (aspect of layla/darkness) that rectifies speech and draws the day's thread of chesed
tmp:0859: ruach piv shel HaKadosh Barukh Hu — the breath of God's mouth, i.e. the aspect of divine speech/dibbur (Chagigah 12b cosmology)
tmp:0860: begadim levanim — white garments, symbol of rectified speech (Malkhut=mouth) that must be kept free of every stain
tmp:0864: speech that draws down Torah-explanations — dibbur flowing from the opened Supernal Heart (via prayer's arousal of mercy) which channels be'urei haTorah
tmp:0865: Midbar Tzin — the Wilderness of Tzin (Num. 20), homiletically 'chilled speech' (dibbur metzunan), where Miriam died and the Well/Torah-explanations departed
tmp:0866: dibbur metzunan — chilled, cooled-off speech, the fallen state of words no longer 'like fiery coals,' causing the soul's departure and loss of Torah-explanations
tmp:0867: the good within speech — the tov in an utterance that makes it heard and accepted ('the good — everyone desires it')
tmp:0868: dibbur nishma v'nitkabel — speech that is heard and accepted, the only utterance that qualifies as true dibbur (vs. Ps. 19:4)
tmp:0871: nivzeh b'einav nim'as — being despised and lowly in one's own eyes (Ps. 15:4), the self-effacement guarding God's honor that lets one speak illuminating words
tmp:0872: anavah v'katnut — humility and smallness/self-effacement, making one's honor as nothing before God's honor, the prerequisite for illuminated speech (Malkhut=mouth)
tmp:0873: speaking words of truth before God — honest speech in hitbodedut/prayer by which God becomes one's light to find the many openings out of darkness and exile
tmp:0874: me'arah — the cave (in Abba Shaul's gravedigger tale), symbol of devekut/attachment ('k'ma'ar ish v'loyot,' I Kings 7)
tmp:0876: devekut achorei hakedushah — the kelipah's parasitic attachment at the 'back' of holiness: Pharaoh (=oref, nape) and his three ministers (windpipe/esophagus/veins) sucking vitality from behind speech
